item.title: China’s Mega Banks Post Record Profits as Margins Recover
item.description: China’s top state banks reported their strongest quarterly profits ever, as improved margins and trading gains from bond investments outweighed sluggish loan growth in a slowing economy.
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg News

item.title: Kalshi, Polymarket Piled On Media Deals Ahead of the Midterms
item.description: Prediction markets have become a growing source of revenue for media companies just ahead of the midterm elections, but not everyone thinks the proliferation of gambling odds in political reporting is a good thing.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Miller

item.title: Tesco Strikes €1.7 Billion Deal to Sell Czech, Slovakia Unit
item.description: Tesco Plc agreed to sell its supermarket arm in Czech Republic and Slovakia to Ahold Delhaize for an enterprise value of €1.7 billion (£1.5 billion), effectively marking the end of its previous plan to become a global grocery giant.
item.dc:creator: Maddie Parker, Charlotte Hughes-Morgan and Daniel Hornak

item.title: Tech Stock Selloff Deepens on Earnings, Oil Rises: Markets Wrap
item.description: US stock futures fell for a second day after another round of disappointing tech earnings accelerated a rotation out of the sector amid signs that the core businesses of America’s tech giants are slowing as they pour money into artificial intelligence. Crude oil gained.
item.dc:creator: Robert Brand and Rivaldo Jantjies

item.title: Taiwan Stocks Near Correction as Global AI Selloff Deepens
item.description: Taiwan’s stock benchmark narrowly avoided a technical correction Friday as a deepening global selloff in artificial intelligence shares hit one of the world’s most AI-exposed markets.
item.dc:creator: Abhishek Vishnoi

item.title: Whistleblowers Claimed Key Oil Tanker Rate Was Manipulated
item.description: The Baltic Exchange has received two whistleblowing claims of attempted manipulation of the world’s benchmark tanker rate since the beginning of the war in Iran, according to documents made public as part of a major legal battle with trading house Mercuria Energy Group.
item.dc:creator: Alex Longley and Jack Farchy

item.title: Bayer Wins Roundup Trial as Settlement Decision Looms
item.description: Bayer AG won a St. Louis trial over its Roundup weedkiller, defeating claims by three women who blamed the herbicide for their cancers and bolstering its efforts to draw a line under its US litigation overhang.
item.dc:creator: Sonja Wind, Sabrina Willmer and Tim Bross

item.title: Genmab’s Stellar Cancer-Drug Data Fuels Stock’s $10 Billion Week
item.description: It’s been a breakout week for Danish biotech Genmab A/S.
item.dc:creator: Margaryta Kirakosian

item.title: UK Wins Back Bond Investors With Dose of Fiscal Restraint
item.description: The rehabilitation of the UK bond market took another step forward as Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s debut budget reassured investors this week, sending yields to a five-week low.
item.dc:creator: Alice Gledhill and Georgia Hall

item.title: Bleak Friday Looms for Stocks: Market Analysis
item.description: Tom Mackenzie, Guy Johnson and Mark Cudmore break down today's key themes for analysts and investors on "Bloomberg: The Opening Trade." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Moody’s Warns of Deeper Losses for Bondholders in Senegal Revamp
item.description: Moody’s Ratings warned that bondholders could face wider-than-expected losses as Senegal seeks to rework billions of dollars of external debt, as it downgraded the West African nation’s credit rating.
item.dc:creator: Ray Ndlovu

item.title: Kia Shares Plunge as Cost Surge Linked to Iran War Hits Profit
item.description: Kia Corp. shares fell to their lowest level in more than a year after the company warned that its earnings are being eroded by mounting costs linked to the war in the Middle East.
item.dc:creator: Hyonhee Shin

item.title: BlackRock Says Bonds Offer Compelling Income Opportunity
item.description: James Turner, BlackRock’s head of global fixed income for EMEA, says bonds offer an "extremely strong" income opportunity with yields at generational highs. "It's just such an attractive time to invest in fixed income," he tells Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Universal Music Subscription Revenue Growth Tops Estimates
item.description: Universal Music Group NV reported stronger-than-expected subscription revenue in the third quarter as price increases and “healthy” subscriber growth helped the world’s largest music label bounce back after two disappointing periods.
item.dc:creator: Charlotte Hughes-Morgan

item.title: Binance says $6.3B Hacked in Crypto Heist
item.description: Horizons Middle East & Africa is your daily spotlight on one of the world's fastest-growing regions. Live from Dubai, we bring you the latest global markets and analysis, plus news-making interviews, with a special focus on MEA. All that and more, as you head to the office in the Gulf, pause for lunch in Hong Kong, or start your day in London or Johannesburg. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: GLP-1 Demand Boosts Dis-Chem’s South Africa Pharmacy Revenue
item.description: Dis-Chem Pharmacies Ltd. said surging demand for GLP-1 medicines is helping drive double-digit growth in its dispensary revenue as South Africans increasingly turn to the expensive drugs used to treat diabetes and obesity.
item.dc:creator: Janice Kew

item.title: Credit Agricole Reports Higher Profit, Warns of France Risk
item.description: Clotilde L'Angevin, deputy general manager at Credit Agricole, speaks on Bloomberg Television after the lender joined its French rivals in reporting higher profit for the third quarter, but warned that the recent turmoil in France could hurt business there in coming months. "Going forward, we want to remain very cautious because it is possible that the macroeconomic environment will have an impact on loan demand," L'Angevin says. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: PHP2Shell Won’t Be the Last Big AI Cybersecurity Risk
item.description: What cybersecurity means in the age of AI.
item.dc:creator: Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway

item.title: Odd Lots: What Cybersecurity Means in the Age of AI (Podcast)
item.description: Earlier this year, cybersecurity researchers discovered a vulnerability in PHP, an open-source coding language used in roughly 70% of the world's websites, that had been lying dormant for a long time, and if exploited, could have led to disaster. And the researchers only understood the extent of this bug through the use of frontier AI models. Today, we talk to two staffers at Calif (CEO Thai Duong and engineer Bruce Dang), the cybersecurity firm that was among the first to discover the PHP vulne
item.dc:creator: Joe Weisenthal and Tracy Alloway

item.title: BP Profit Hits 18-Year High as Oil Refining Margins Surge
item.description: BP Plc said profit surged to the highest in 18 years as soaring refining margins boosted earnings, while a sharp drop in net debt moved the British energy major closer to a position where it could restart buybacks.
item.dc:creator: Mitchell Ferman
